description: Where an app stands between its draft, pre and pro. Changes wait in the app's draft, and each app has a `target` environment: "pro" (what the users have) or "pre" (a private copy the developer tests). "status": { target, draft: { count, files: [{ path, op: put|delete }], settings: [field], savedAt, dropped }, pre: what pre has that pro does not (only with target "pre") }; draft.dropped lists changes Neblla took out because they no longer fit its settings. "diff": what pre has that pro does not (files added/changed/removed, settings), plus `draft`. "releases": the last versions the users had (Neblla keeps the last 10), newest first: { keep, releases: [{ id, at, by: { email, via }, changes, files, rollbackOf, current }], queued }; an entry with id null is from before the history and cannot be sent again. Changes nothing; neblla_promote publishes, discards and rolls back.
name: neblla_promote_read
title: Promote (read)
